FOLATE Pteroylmonoglutamic acids (folates) are reduced to 
tetrahydrofolate or active folate that is poly-glutamated (has
glutamic acids attached) and whose activity varies by the num-
ber of g-carboxylic acid-linked glutamates available. Methyl 
tetrahydrofolate (mTHF) participates as a cofactor for many 
enzymatic reactions, but particularly in 1 carbon transfer for
the following functions:
•
Th e synthesis of thymidine for DNA
•
Th e synthesis of purines for RNA
•
Remethylation of homocysteine to methionine
•
Conversion of methionine to SAMe
